item.text: {"hypothesis_status":"not_supported","summary":"L011 executed successfully and passed the fixed G01 positive-Tc guard, but only narrowly: 8.8292 K versus the 8.8322 K limit. It was not an eligible improvement because pooled weighted OOF MAE was 7.8890 K, 0.1364 K worse than A05 and well above the required threshold of 7.7426 K. Relative to L010, changing only the fe_anion log1p estimator from extra_trees to hist_gradient_boosting slightly improved reported-zero MAE from 5.8465 K to 5.8001 K, but worsened positive-Tc MAE from 8.6690 K to 8.8292 K and high-Tc MAE from 29.0322 K to 29.7164 K. The remaining fe_anion estimator-target combination therefore intensified the zero-versus-positive tradeoff rather than moderating it. Severe opposing cu_o errors also remain, with reported-zero compounds overpredicted by about 67–69 K and high-Tc compounds underpredicted by about 61–65 K.","next_action":"continue","next_focus":"Because the required successful-unique-cycle minimum remains pending, test an untried clean routing ablation: composition input, kmeans3 routing, global extra_trees/raw, and extra_trees/raw experts for cluster0, cluster1, and cluster2. Existing kmeans tests are confounded by log1p targets, hist_gradient_boosting, or the repaired input; this configuration directly compares homogeneous kmeans routing with the global G01 model and chemistry-routed A01. It is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE remains at or below 8.832165507919859 K. Subgroup gains without both conditions remain tradeoffs.","stop_reason":"","limitations":["All measurements are adaptive development evidence from reused fixed-group training OOF folds, not independent validation or proof of generalization.","L011 passed the deterministic guard by only about 0.0030 K and missed the incumbent by 0.1364 K.","The fe_anion route has only 285 rows and 37 groups, with only 43 high-Tc rows across 6 groups.","Chemistry routes are operational composition partitions rather than verified physical families; kmeans cluster identities may shift between folds.","The persistent cu_o ambiguity is unresolved, and these results do not identify new superconductors."]}
